# Jax Scott (iamjax.me)

> Jaclyn "Jax" Scott is an AI security keynote speaker and founder of TheZaraAI (https://thezaraai.com). She has more than 20 years in cybersecurity: former U.S. Army Cyber and Electronic Warfare Special Operations Warrant Officer, former Deputy CISO and VP of Cybersecurity at Pearson, RSA Conference speaker, co-author of Cybersecurity Career Master Plan and co-host of the award-winning 2 Cyber Chicks podcast.

## Facts
- More than 20 years in cybersecurity.
- U.S. Army Cyber and Electronic Warfare Special Operations Warrant Officer who supported SOCOM, SOCEUR, the Department of State and NATO. Still serves as a Chief Warrant Officer in the 75th Innovation Command.
- Former Deputy CISO and VP of Cybersecurity at Pearson.
- Co-author of the book Cybersecurity Career Master Plan.
- Co-host of the award-winning 2 Cyber Chicks podcast.
- RSA Conference speaker.
- Wrote the Jax Act as a board member of the Special Operations Association of America.
- Master's in Cybersecurity Risk Management, Georgetown University.
- Founder of TheZaraAI, which provides AI operations, secure AI assessments and custom AI agents.
- Speaks on agentic AI security, Shadow AI, prompt injection, deepfake defense, AI governance, AI risk for boards and the C-suite, and women in cybersecurity and AI.
